text: Many experts believe artificial intelligence will continue to evolve, perhaps leading to Artificial General Intelligence, or AGI. Unlike today’s narrow AI, which can only perform specific tasks, AGI would be able to learn and reason like a human across many different areas. This could bring huge benefits, such as solving complex problems in medicine or climate change. However, there are also serious risks. Some worry AGI could be misused or become difficult to control. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary widely. Some think it may happen within the next few decades, while others believe it will take much longer. Either way, its development promises to change our world profoundly.
